[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]provider detects aborted turns, and the sudo skill prevents the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]yield-and-abandon pattern.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Gate-creation intent marker and host adjudication[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]gate-intent-adjudication[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gate-intent-adjudication: write a durable intent marker at the top of [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the shared agent-side gate creation path and make the host runner [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lifecycle fail the run with a needs-attention notification when an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]intent is left unconsumed.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Codex provider turn-integrity detection[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]codex-turn-integrity[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]codex-turn-integrity: treat a codex turn that ends with an empty final [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]answer plus a command killed at teardown as a provider failure that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]raises for retry instead of returning success.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Sudo skill foreground-execution guidance[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]sudo-skill-foreground-guidance[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]sudo-skill-foreground-guidance: update the generated sase_sudo skill [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]template to require foreground execution of sase sudo request and to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]state that any returned tool result means the turn did not end.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]End-to-end verification of the sudo handoff[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]sudo-e2e-verification[dim] · [dim][/dim]after gate-intent-adjudication, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]codex-turn-integrity, sudo-skill-foreground-guidance[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]sudo-e2e-verification: re-run the /root/foobar sudo request to confirm [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gate, bundle, and notification creation, and simulate a killed CLI to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]confirm the run now fails loudly.[/#D7D7AF]
